job.job_description:
Role - AI-Augmented Software Developer

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: 3-5 Years




Mandatory: Strong AI-powered portfolio showcasing real-world projects.




Role Overview - -

We are looking for an experienced Software Developer who actively utilizes AI technologies and modern development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate workflows, and build next-generation applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience developing AI-assisted applications and integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into real-world products.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain AI-powered web applications using Python and React/Next.js.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate software development and improve productivity.
Build and integrate LLM, RAG, and workflow automation solutions.
Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a remote environment.
Deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality software solutions.



Requirements

3-5 years of software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience with Next.js or React.js and Tailwind CSS.
Good understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, and deployment pipelines.
Experience with LLMs, RAG, and AI-powered application development.
Hands on of workflow automation and AI-assisted development tools.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.





Full Job Description - https://shorturl.at/cRBHz
